item.title: RedOS 0.5.1
item.description:
• chore: version 0.5.1
  • ci: bump actions/checkout to v7 and actions/cache to v6
  • ci(M9): GitHub Actions CI and release workflows, release secrets setup, Dependabot
  • feat(M8): routines with schedule and app triggers, persistent memory, selected-text requests, cloud usage limit and offline mode

item.title: RedOS 0.5.0
item.description:
• chore: version 0.5.0
  • feat(M7): Sparkle updates (EdDSA, stable/beta channels), release packaging and publishing scripts
  • feat(M5): accessibility actions (ui.press/fill/read), shell.run, observe-act screen agent, HUD and kill switch
  • feat: instant fast-path plans, local multi-step planning, confirmation only when needed, spoken yes/no and voice-language phrases
  • feat: push-to-talk voice commands with on-device SpeechAnalyzer and spoken answers (M4)
  • perf: 2.7x faster System One/Two (few-shot cached prompts, e2b extraction, Ollama 2 slots), native Jev decision models support, holdout eval
  • feat: System Two with selectable providers (Ollama, Copilot CLI, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini), answers and Settings window (M3)
  • feat: multi-step requests via local System Two planner, url.open action
  • feat: command history with up/down arrows in the command panel
  • feat: System One eval set, chained argument extraction and safer defaults (M2.5)
  • chore: ignore bun build artifacts
  • feat: System One routing via Jev protocol, Ollama logprobs and optional LocalJev (M2)
  • feat: command panel, global hotkey and action engine (M1)
  • docs: add MIT license
  • chore: bootstrap RedOS menu bar app (M0)
